description: A multi use trail along the kaslo river.
directions: Bottom of Trail: Drive west on highway 31A to the Keen Creek Road. Take the gravel on the right of the highway, across from Keen Creek Road. Drive approx 1.0km to old gravel pit. Road on north end of pit is beginning of trail. Top of Trail: Drive west on highway 31A to road junction on right, before Rossitter Creek. Drive approx 2.0km to trailhead. Follow marked bike route on old roadbed and gravel logging road sections for approx 15.0km.
title: KASLO RIVER TRAILWAY (Wagon Road)
